The new query reads the bookings file directly instead of going through the repository port. It also copies the file adapter's storage format. I found no other problems in the changed units.

- **Direct `std::fs` access:** `GuestHistory::handle` (`guest_history.rs:20-24`) calls `fs::read_to_string` on a path it holds. This breaks `ports`, since `std::fs` belongs only in `ports/<port>/file.rs`. It also holds a `PathBuf` rather than an `Rc<dyn BookingRepository>`. That is the `adapters-main` shape, so `main.rs` would have to pass it a path instead of the repository. The in-memory adapter can never serve this query, because `handle` only reads a file. The fix is to add a method such as `bookings_for(guest)` to the `BookingRepository` trait, implement it in both adapters, and have the query hold the repository.
- **Duplicated tab-separated format:** `parse_line` (`guest_history.rs:35-50`) is a copy of the parser in `file.rs:35`. If the adapter's format changes, this query will silently skip every line it can no longer parse. Moving the read behind the port removes this duplicate.
